phase_prompt.summary: The narrator’s death in a mystical ancient‑tech chamber
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, cinematic still of a scholar narrator’s death in a dimly lit stone chamber, their body collapsing as bioluminescent spores swirl around them, the skin glowing with faint iridescent veins, and the body beginning to crystallize into a lattice of translucent shards etched with Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs, illuminated by a low pulsing light from an incomprehensible central device projecting holographic glyphs onto the walls, with a flowing robe woven from metallic thread and crystalline accents, conveying grounded realism and industrial mysticism
